headline: German companies in Latvia advance investment projects worth over 600 million euros
summary: During a trade mission in Berlin organized by the Latvian Investment and Development Agency, investment projects of German companies worth over €600 million were advanced.
why: Foreign direct investment from large economies such as Germany supports capital formation and jobs in host countries like Latvia.
